description.text: BNU will offer “English-Taught Credit Course Program” in 78 courses, hoping to enroll overseas students. All the courses are designed for students who not only possess a high professional proficiency but are also familiar with Chinese society and culture. Study Duration and Study Mode Students should choose three to five courses among below 61 courses for one semester. After you finish the course, you will get the credit and could use it at your own country study. You could download the detail information of the courses here: Introduction to English-Taught Credit-Course Program

duration.text: The English-Taught Credit-Course Program at Beijing Normal University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1722 USD/per semester ￥ 12400 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of highest education 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. Materials must be in English 6. Two letters of recommendation From the applicant's former or present teachers and the teacher should sign for recommendation letters (must be in English)

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be age of 18 to 45 years old and above 2.High school graduate or equivalent or above
